data_boundary.candidate_comparisons: Only exposed orders 1-13 and committed TF2/TF3 outputs.
data_boundary.order14: Timing only. No order-14 invariant value was persisted, printed, ranked, or compared with any candidate.

diagnosis.ratios_only: The one-feature homogeneous grammar is the primary scientific limitation: most TF3 coefficients were boundary fits that drifted immediately on exposed larger orders, while the stable forms were K1-invalid, elementary, or already falsified historically.
diagnosis.hypothesis_domain: The literal all-tree statement and discovery orders 2-10 are mismatched. Changing to a nontrivial-tree hypothesis would not change generator output, so TF4 keeps the all-tree domain and adds an exposed K1 domain-consistency check before fresh validation.
diagnosis.feature_vocabulary: No feature change is justified. maximal_independent_set_count is qualitatively different and dominates many pairwise survivors, but removing it now would confound the grammar experiment.
diagnosis.target: No target change is justified by the exposed evidence.
diagnosis.selected_axis: Replace ratios-only generation with fixed pairwise convex-hull generation over all 21 unordered pairs of the same seven features, followed only by exact cross-run deduplication.
